title: P22: a tailnet-range address was committed in evidence/p22/chain_start.txt (ssh error line); no AC-5 scan was run or reported before the commit
what_went_wrong: evidence/p22/chain_start.txt line 4 held the address printed by an ssh 'Connection reset by peer' error; the P22 commit contained it.
R5 section 34 and the task doc section 7 reported no AC-5 scan; I scanned the v13 builder output and the P21 diff but not the P22 evidence.
root_cause: Evidence from the box was committed with its error output unfiltered, and my pre-commit scan used a pattern with a fixed context width (30 characters before the address, 20 after), so a line with fewer than 30 characters before the address ('Read from remote host <addr>') could not match. The scan therefore reported no hit and I read that as clean.
impact: None outside the machine: the commit was local only (origin at f771e04). The local P22 commit was rebuilt without the address; the old commits sit on backup-pre-redact-20261031 (delete before any push of that branch).

correction.applied: address replaced by <host>; local commits rebuilt; AC-5 scan re-run on the rebuilt commit and its result recorded in R5 section 35.

rule: Before every commit of box output, scan the whole staged diff for addresses with a plain pattern (no required context width, no head), read every hit, and state the scan and its result in the wave's report.
